[issue by mqnowa]

#### minecraft version
> Minecraft 1.18.1
> fablic 0.13.1

#### installd mods
> fablic api 0.46.4+1.18
> optifablic 1.12.10
> optifine HD U H4
> Architectury 3.4.17

If this is a bug caused by using the unofficial launcher, multi MC, please close it.
